sloka: न हि एवम् रमणीयेषु शाद्वलेषु तया सह ।रमतो मे भवेत् चिन्ता न स्पृहा अन्येषु वा भवेत् ॥४-१-९६॥
transliteration: na hi evam ramaṇīyeṣu śādvaleṣu tayā saha ।ramato me bhavet cintā na spṛhā anyeṣu vā bhavet ॥4-1-96॥

translations.english: 'If I can sport with Sita in this beautiful green grassy land, I will not have any worry, I would not desire for any other pleasure.
